## Background

Trains the Hugging Face VLA baselines — SmolVLA and π0 via LeRobot —
on the same B2 dataset and splits as
[C1](../C1-groot-finetuning/README.qmd). Keeping the data, splits, and
evaluation protocol identical isolates the model variable, so the C3
comparison speaks to architecture and pretraining scale rather than
data differences. Also the fallback path: if GR00T's embodiment
adaptation stalls, SmolVLA's lighter footprint keeps the thesis's
experimental core viable.
